claims.evidence: The photos show stacks of tires which suggests volume, but business status cannot be verified remotely.
The origin of the tires (imported used) is not visible in the photos provided.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired or structurally compromised due to age.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the 4-digit DOT date codes on the sidewalls.

risks.risk: Tread depth may be at or below the legal safety limit.
risks.proof: Photos of a tread depth gauge or a coin inserted into the grooves of multiple tires.

risks.risk: Hidden internal damage, such as patches, plugs, or sidewall repairs.
risks.proof: Photos of the interior carcass of the tires.

risks.risk: Damaged beads preventing a proper airtight seal on the rim.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the inner bead circumference for each tire.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of DOT date codes for a representative sample.
Photos of the inside of the tires to check for patches or gaiters.
Tread depth measurements for the different stacks.
Clear photos of the sidewall specifications for all tires in the foreground.
response.reason: The witness has identified the items as used tires and confirmed the R22.5 size for at least some units. They can be priced at the base casing value for that size until quality and age are proven.
